changes.title: Wait for npm dist-tag updates to become visible
changes.body:
## Summary

npm accepted the `latest` update for `0.1.2`, but the next registry read still showed a different value. The release job stopped before creating the Git tag and publishing the GitHub release. [Failed release attempt](https://github.com/dumptruckman/ouch4ts/actions/runs/45234959803/job/137904099153)

```text
Write the dist-tag once → read it immediately → retry reads every five seconds if needed
```

The workflow logs stale or missing values and the version it eventually confirms. After five minutes it reports the last reason confirmation was pending and points to the original run for recovery.

## Evidence

The regression test reproduced the production error with one stale read. It now verifies that the release finishes after exactly one tag update. Deadline tests cover both a stale version and a missing tag.

All 374 tests, typecheck, and build passed.

## Merge danger

The change affects npm release automation. Merging with `release:patch` triggers a preview. The rolling release PR controls stable publication.
changes.head: jwood/retry-release-tag-confirmation
